# FidelityFX Super Resolution 1

Unmodified AMD MIT-licensed `ffx_a.h` and `ffx_fsr1.h` from
https://github.com/GPUOpen-Effects/FidelityFX-FSR at revision
`a21ffb8f6c13233ba336352bdff293894c706575`, reused from the read-only TOU checkout.
CMake embeds GLSL sources; `platform/portable_fsr.inc` integrates full-precision
EASU/RCAS for gameplay presentation. Binary packages include `FSR-LICENSE.txt`.
